Test_Objective: Verify logged-in user can open Secret Box from Awards tab
Precondition: User logged in with valid session
Steps:
1. Login successfully
2. Go to Awards tab
3. Tap entry to Secret Box
Expected_Result: Secret Box screen displays with box image and unopened count

Test_Objective: Verify tapping box starts opening animation when unopened count > 0
Steps:
1. On Secret Box screen
2. Tap the gift box image
3. Observe animation and result
Expected_Result: Opening animation plays then standby state with prize label and Continue button

Test_Objective: Verify Continue returns to closed state after revealing prize
Steps:
1. Complete box open flow to standby
2. Tap Tiếp tục
3. Observe screen
Expected_Result: Returns to closed state; unopened count decremented by 1

Test_Objective: Verify box cannot be opened when unopened count is 0
Steps:
1. Open Secret Box with 0 unopened boxes
2. Tap box image
Expected_Result: No opening animation; subtitle indicates all boxes opened

Test_Objective: Verify Secret Box layout matches Figma
Steps:
1. Open Secret Box
2. Verify title, subtitle, box image, counter
Expected_Result: Title KHÁM PHÁ SECRET BOX, box image centered, unopened count displayed
